subject.title: Browser: add ChatGPT Scheduled task controls

question: Should Oracle support ChatGPT Scheduled task creation and conversation pinning as first-class browser CLI commands, despite relying on ChatGPT’s evolving `/scheduled` DOM and lifecycle?
rationale: The patch introduces new CLI/config/session behavior rather than repairing an established contract, so maintainers must choose whether this is a supported product surface before a mechanical implementation fix is sufficient.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow browser workflow
options.body: Accept the two flags as supported browser functionality, contingent on explicit task-creation verification, a rebase, and inspectable real-run proof.

options.title: Keep the browser scope to conversational runs
options.body: Do not merge this feature surface and leave Scheduled-task management to ChatGPT’s native interface until a broader product direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow browser workflow
recommendation.body: Accept the two flags as supported browser functionality, contingent on explicit task-creation verification, a rebase, and inspectable real-run proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is direct ownership of the existing browser action and completion path.
